independent_check: The logarithm calculation is exact in the limit; the example has additive variances. It is not asserted to be FPP.
method: Subdiffusive and KPZ passage-time fluctuation exponents structural argument
obstruction: Known sublinear-variance estimates leave a polynomial-exponent gap. An additional power saving, and a matching lower bound for identification, are required.
result: A variance upper bound of order n/log n does not establish an exponent below1/2. Indeed log(n/log n)/(2log n) tends to1/2. Sums of floor(n/log n) independent mean-zero variance-one variables realize that variance order in an elementary model.
